body: Checked with 6,063 tickets at 390x844, 699, 700, 701 and 768 px: on phones selecting a ticket switches to a single-column detail at the top (h1 at y≈166, page height = viewport), 'Back to tickets' restores filter text, list scroll position and marks the last opened ticket (data-recent, not aria-current); wider layouts keep list and detail side by side. Desktop: list and detail now scroll independently (app shell has viewport height), so navigation stays reachable while reading long tickets/documents. Fixed: navigating during the initial tree load was reset to Overview when loading finished.
author: claude
